data.long_meaning: The name Anett is a Hungarian form of Anne, derived from the Hebrew name Hannah, which means grace. In the Bible, Anne is the mother of the Virgin Mary, making this name deeply rooted in Christian tradition. The name Anett carries the meaning “Anne, grace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Anett usually hope their child will grow to embody anne, grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine grace and motherly love.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anett total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
